heading: INT. MERCY GENERAL HOSPITAL - NURSES' STATION - NIGHT

units.text: INT. MERCY GENERAL HOSPITAL - NURSES' STATION - NIGHT
We see a long hallway with flickering fluorescent lights, which is a metaphor for how the main character feels inside.
It is 3 AM.
CLOSE ON a clock on the wall.
THE NEW GIRL, 19, sits at the station in oversized scrubs, her badge flipped backwards.
She is clearly nervous and has never worked a night shift before, which we can tell because she keeps looking at her phone.
Okay. Okay. Breathe.
units.name: THE NEW GIRL
paren: straightening a stack of charts that are already straight, then knocking them over

units.text: A voice crackles from the intercom.
Station, it's Bea. Are you there?
units.name: CHARGE NURSE

units.text: Yes! Here! Station! Hi!
units.name: THE NEW GIRL
paren: grabbing the handset too hard, nearly dropping it

units.text: Room 12's call light is on. Can you check on Mr. Kessler?
units.name: CHARGE NURSE

units.text: Totally. Absolutely. Going now.
units.name: THE NEW GIRL
paren: standing, tripping on her own lanyard

units.text: We see her walk down the hallway to Room 12, past a vending machine that hums.
She stops outside the door.
Who's that? Is that Kim?
units.name: KESSLER

units.text: It's not Kim, Mr. Kessler. It's... it's me. The new one.
units.name: THE NEW GIRL
paren: sighing, opening the door a crack

units.text: Oh. Kip said you'd be shorter.
units.name: KESSLER

units.text: Kip is the other night nurse. He says a lot of things.
units.name: THE NEW GIRL
paren: laughing, wiping her eyes with the back of her hand

units.text: You've got kind hands. I can hear it in your steps.
units.name: KESSLER

units.text: Thank you. I think that's the nicest thing anyone has said all week.
units.name: THE NEW GIRL
paren: pausing in the doorway, pressing a hand to her chest

units.text: The intercom crackles again.
Priya, you still there? Your mom's on line two. She says you left your lunch in the car.
units.name: CHARGE NURSE

units.text: I'm going to quit. I'm going to quit tonight.
units.name: PRIYA
paren: burying her face in her hands, shoulders shaking with laughter

units.text: You won't.
units.name: KESSLER

units.text: CUT TO:
